report:
Reviewed the complete claim and association set: one ordinary implementation in infer_ctx.rs, the ordinary body_finalization_resolves_types_into_a_fresh_stash test, and the explicit semantic_spec TODO. Independently verified exact byte equality of all three current source files with the historical input; that comparison supports reuse of unchanged source reasoning, not an automatic approval.

Body ownership: InferCtx owns its egraph (variables and versions), runtime, obligations, target stash and expression slots; new constructs fresh per-context state and finish consumes self. Publication requires no pending obligations, no live branch below ROOT, a quiescent runtime, and no unpublished wakes before constructing CheckedBody. Finalization resolves root inference representatives and recursively rebuilds expressions, patterns, type arguments, annotations and nested types into a fresh stash; a surviving InferVar panics instead of entering the returned tree. Captured finalizer helpers supplement the initial implementation context.

The complete ordinary test explicitly binds an inference variable to i32, places it inside the root tuple type, finalizes, and asserts the source still contains InferVar while the output tuple element is i32. This meaningfully detects failure to resolve nested tuple inference and in-place mutation, but does not exercise finish's live-work guards or prove the complete tree matrix. The TODO explicitly preserves those gaps: representative inference-free completed trees, rejection of live variables/obligations/tasks/branches, and separate expected diagnostic-recovery output. Its prerequisite is constructing controlled live-state finish fixtures and representative body/recovery assertions; the guards and lowering exist, but this verification matrix remains unimplemented. The empty TODO body supplies no behavioral proof. The historical rationale remains sufficient with these limits, and no additional edits are requested; acceptance does not promote deferred coverage to implemented evidence.

Method: source inspection plus exact historical-source comparison and review start/read/record commands. No behavioral tests or workspace build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator reports 321 sage-meta tests and a root build passing; that is separately supplied execution evidence, not this reviewer's execution or proof of the deferred matrix.
